about: Catalogue of the descriptive idioms in the publisher schema.org markup of the Docklands web harvest. Each idiom: candidate nodes (a SPARQL WHERE pattern binding ?x), a core ShEx shape and form shapes in idioms.shex (prefix i:), optional SPARQL forms, and the rewrite to the canonical layer. Content idioms describe businesses; furniture idioms are SEO-plugin output. Tool: magpie/cwplans/tools/web-idioms.mjs (Factoidal).

sparql_forms.LastItemUnlinked: ASK { ?x s:itemListElement ?li . ?li s:position ?p . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?x s:itemListElement ?l2 . ?l2 s:position ?p2 . FILTER(xsd:integer(?p2) > xsd:integer(?p)) } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?li s:item ?it } }
